sub_graphs.title: Prague: Block Context Read Operations
sub_graphs.description: Models the EVM instructions that read block-level context information

nodes.label: EVM Executing Code
nodes.description: EVM is executing bytecode and encounters a block instruction

nodes.label: Execute COINBASE (0x41)
nodes.description: Read current block's beneficiary address and push to stack

nodes.label: Execute TIMESTAMP (0x42)
nodes.description: Read current block's Unix timestamp and push to stack

nodes.label: Execute NUMBER (0x43)
nodes.description: Read current block number and push to stack

nodes.label: Execute PREVRANDAO (0x44)
nodes.description: Read beacon chain randomness value and push to stack

nodes.label: Execute GASLIMIT (0x45)
nodes.description: Read current block's gas limit and push to stack

nodes.label: Execute CHAINID (0x46)
nodes.description: Read network chain identifier and push to stack

nodes.label: Value Pushed to Stack
nodes.description: Block context value is now on top of EVM stack

nodes.label: Charge Base Gas
nodes.description: Deduct 2 gas (GAS_BASE) for operation

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter
nodes.description: Advance PC by 1 to next instruction

external_entities.name: Block Producer

nodes.label: BLOCKHASH Requested

nodes.label: Check Stack Underflow
nodes.description: Verify stack has at least 1 element

nodes.label: Charge BLOCKHASH Gas
nodes.description: Deduct 20 gas (GAS_BLOCK_HASH)

nodes.label: Check if Future Block
nodes.description: Check if requested block > current block number

nodes.label: Check if Current Block
nodes.description: Check if requested block == current block number

nodes.label: Retrieve Historical Block Hash

nodes.label: Out of Gas Error

ambiguities.text: The PREVRANDAO instruction is described as returning 'beacon chain's randomness value' but the exact source and timing of this value is not specified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume PREVRANDAO returns the randao_mix from the parent beacon block, as specified in EIP-4399.

ambiguities.text: The behavior when block number 0 (genesis) is requested via BLOCKHASH is not explicitly defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume genesis block hash can be returned if within 256 block lookback range, otherwise returns zero.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'one of 256 most recent blocks' is ambiguous about whether the count includes or excludes the current block
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the 256 block range is [current - 256, current - 1], excluding the current block.

implicit_assumptions.description: Block context values (coinbase, timestamp, etc.) are correctly set by the block producer and verified by consensus
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Malicious block producers could inject arbitrary values, breaking contracts that rely on these for security-critical decisions

implicit_assumptions.description: Validators cannot predict or manipulate PREVRANDAO values beyond their own influence on randao reveals
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Predictable randomness could be exploited in applications using PREVRANDAO for random selection (gambling, NFT mints)

implicit_assumptions.description: TIMESTAMP is monotonically increasing and approximately reflects real-world time
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Non-monotonic or significantly incorrect timestamps could break time-dependent contract logic

implicit_assumptions.description: Block hashes for the most recent 256 blocks are always available in state
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Missing block hash data could cause BLOCKHASH to return incorrect zero values for valid block numbers

implicit_assumptions.description: CHAIN_ID is immutable and correctly identifies the network
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Chain ID manipulation could enable replay attacks across networks
